note: For every word the archive holds on its own evidence, a link to Paul Strack's Eldamo entry for it. Strack's glosses are stored only in fields namespaced eldamo_*, never in the archive's own voice: Eldamo is a scholarly compilation and much of it is reconstruction, while this archive cites the 49 volumes for every claim it makes. The reader gets Strack's depth; the archive keeps saying only what it can cite.
